judge_panel.matching_evidence:
The paper states robustness for N_max ∈ [50, 200] but a more careful justification is needed:

- The correlation time of MRI turbulence is typically a fraction of an orbit, not 100 orbits. A piecewise-constant model with very long N_max effectively biases the variance of the cumulative dephasing upward (since σ̂_turb ∝ √N_max). The authors should test a wider range, e.g., N_max ∈ [1, 1000]
